description:
**Job Information**
-------------------

* Date Opened 10/22/2026
* Job Type Full time
* Industry Human Resources
* Work Experience 1-3 years
* Remote Job

**Job Description**
-------------------

This is a remote position.

Website: https://fyerx.com

Experience Required: 1–3 years

Work Arrangement: Work from Home

Employment Type: Full-time

Salary: ₹1.2-1.5 LPA for the initial 12 months + Incentives

Salary After 1 Year: ₹2.5 LPA + Incentives

  

**Role Overview**

We are looking for a proactive and result-oriented Junior Talent Acquisition Specialist to manage recruitment for technical roles. The ideal candidate should have experience in sourcing, screening, and coordinating IT professionals across different technologies and experience levels.

The candidate should be comfortable working in a remote environment, managing multiple job requirements, maintaining regular follow-ups, and delivering quality candidate profiles within agreed timelines.

Key Responsibilities

* Understand technical job requirements and candidate specifications shared by hiring managers or clients.
* Source suitable IT candidates through LinkedIn, Naukri, Indeed, job portals, professional networks, employee referrals, social media, and internal databases.
* Screen resumes and shortlist candidates based on technical skills, relevant experience, project exposure, location, availability, notice period, and compensation expectations.
* Conduct initial screening calls to assess candidates’ communication skills, technical background, job interest, and overall suitability for the role.
* Source candidates for IT roles such as Software Developers, Full Stack Developers, Frontend Developers, Backend Developers, Java Developers, Python Developers, React Developers, Angular Developers, DevOps Engineers, Cloud Engineers, QA Engineers, Data Analysts, UI/UX Designers, Business Analysts, and other technical positions.
* Coordinate interviews between shortlisted candidates and hiring managers.
* Follow up with candidates and stakeholders for interview availability, interview feedback, selection updates, documentation, and joining status.
* Share candidate profiles in the required format, along with relevant details such as current CTC, expected CTC, notice period, location, and availability.
* Maintain accurate candidate records, job status, interview schedules, sourcing details, and recruitment trackers using Zoho Recruit, ATS platforms, Excel, Google Sheets, or other relevant tools.
* Build and maintain a strong database of IT professionals for current and future hiring requirements.
* Ensure a positive candidate experience through clear, timely, and professional communication throughout the recruitment process.
* Assist with offer coordination, document collection, background-verification follow-ups, and joining formalities when required.
* Meet assigned sourcing, submission, interview, and closure targets.
* Stay updated on current IT skills, technology trends, recruitment practices, and sourcing methods.

  
  

### **Requirements**

* Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field.

* 1–3 years of experience in IT recruitment, technical recruitment, talent acquisition, or staffing recruitment.

* Experience in sourcing and hiring candidates for technical and IT roles.

* Basic understanding of IT technologies, skills, job titles, and technical recruitment terminology.

* Familiarity with technologies such as Java, Python, .NET, React, Angular, Node.js, SQL, AWS, Azure, DevOps, testing, data analytics, and cloud platforms is preferred.

* Strong experience using LinkedIn, Naukri, Indeed, job portals, Boolean search, social-media sourcing, and referral-based recruitment.

* Familiarity with Zoho Recruit, ATS, HRMS, CRM, or recruitment-tracking tools will be an added advantage.

* Good verbal and written communication skills in English.

* Strong follow-up, negotiation, coordination, time-management, and stakeholder-management skills.

* Ability to work independently, prioritize multiple open requirements, and meet deadlines in a remote work environment.

* High level of professionalism, ownership, attention to detail, and confidentiality.

  
  

### **Benefits**

If you have a passion for IT recruitment, candidate sourcing, and connecting skilled professionals with the right opportunities, we encourage you to apply for the Junior Talent Acquisition Specialist role at FyerX.

The Application Vulnerability Management Specialist is a security-focused individual contributor responsible for identifying, prioritising and coordinating the remediation of vulnerabilities across WSP’s COTS and Microsoft 365 application portfolio. The estate includes:

* Collaboration — tools that connect people and teams (e.g. Zoom, Teams).
* Productivity — applications that support day-to-day business output (e.g. Microsoft 365 Apps, Adobe Acrobat, Google Workspace, Smartsheet).
* Utilities — general end-user desktop utilities that support the estate (e.g. WinZip / 7-Zip, TeamViewer, Notepad++, Snagit).

Using Microsoft Defender Vulnerability Management, Intune and ServiceNow, you will turn vulnerability data into clear priorities, coordinate remediation with technical teams and suppliers, and report progress to stakeholders. You will apply risk factors such as CVSS, EPSS, CISA KEV, asset criticality and business impact to reduce exposure while maintaining operational stability across a global environment.

  

Identify and Prioritise Risk

* Maintain an accurate view of application vulnerabilities, affected devices and remediation status using Defender Vulnerability Management, Intune and ServiceNow.
* Assess and prioritise findings using CVSS, EPSS, CISA KEV, exploit intelligence, asset criticality and business context.
Monitor vulnerabilities, misconfigurations and security-baseline gaps across COTS and Microsoft 365 applications.  

Coordinate Remediation

* Coordinate patching, configuration changes and other mitigations with End User Device, deployment, engineering and supplier teams.
* Manage findings from validation through remediation, verification and closure, with clear ownership and agreed service levels.
Manage time-bound exceptions and risk acceptances, documenting compensating controls and reviewing them at expiry.  

Improve Security Practices

* Support application hardening, security-baseline compliance and attack-surface reduction using recognised Microsoft, CIS and industry guidance.
* Promote least privilege and controlled elevation through endpoint privilege management practices and tooling.
Contribute security and vulnerability requirements to the onboarding and review of business applications.  

Report and Govern

* Provide clear dashboards and reports on exposure, remediation progress, SLA performance, ageing, recurrence and security-baseline compliance.
* Translate trends and technical findings into practical recommendations for management, audit and operational teams.
* Maintain proportionate procedures and evidence aligned with ITSM, ISO/IEC 27001 and relevant vulnerability-management guidance.

  

Essential

* 5+ years in an ITIL-aligned security or IT operations role, ideally in vulnerability management, endpoint security or business applications.
* Hands-on experience with Microsoft Defender Vulnerability Management and the Microsoft Defender portal.
* Working knowledge of Microsoft 365 applications, endpoint patching and deployment through Intune and/or Configuration Manager.

"Role Overview
  
  
The NTT DATA Services Security Analysis Specialist Advisor works to ensure the seamless delivery of all information security services that NTT DATA provides to the customer.
  
This is an individual contributor role in which the person acts as a trusted information security partner with the customer and works collaboratively to understand, anticipate and recommend risk mitigation while promoting the overall information security protection for the customer’s information assets. You will partner with client to align information security with the customer’s business strategy, security policies and regulatory and compliance requirements resulting in increased protection and reduced risk.
  
  
Role Responsibilities (high level summary of key duties)
  
The responsibilities of the Security Analysis Specialist Advisor include:
  

* Ensure the delivery of information security services to the customer in compliance with the contract and any applicable standards and regulatory requirements (e.g., PCI, SOX)
* Assist client in the definition and implementation of information security policies, strategies, procedures and settings to ensure confidentiality, integrity and availability of client’s environment and data
* Participate with customer in the strategic design process to translate security and business requirements into processes and systems; evaluating new / emerging security products and technologies and making recommendations to customer leadership in regards to the security posture impact on the organization
* Identify, review and recommend information security improvements as they relate to the achievement of the customer’s business goals and objectives
* Participate in internal and external audits for the customer (e.g., SOX, PCI) and coordinate information security services activities
* Drive remediation efforts related to information security; remediation may be from incidents, penetration tests, vulnerability scans, internal/external audits and Critical Practice assessments
* Identify information security weaknesses and/or gaps in the customer’s current operations and work with the customer to bring information security operations up to standards
* Participate and represent IT Security in Delivery/Operational meetings
* Review service management reports to ensure tickets (i.e., incidents, problems, requests, changes), related to information security, are being acknowledged, worked and Service Level Agreements are being met; provide direction on ticket remediation and ensure remediation is complete

**Required Qualifications:**  

* 12+ years of relevant experience
* Knowledge of standards / regulations impacting information security (e.g., PCI, HIPAA, SOX)
* Applied knowledge of risk management concepts
* Experience with information security internal external audits, contract compliance, and quality initiatives

* At least one of the following certifications: CISSP, SSCP, CISM, CEH
* Undergraduate or graduate degree
* Customer relationship management experience at the senior level
* Strong knowledge of systems and network administration (i.e., desktop, server)
* Knowledge and application of Globally Accepted Information Security Principles
* Strong knowledge of network security that pertains to communications, computer system environments and related infrastructures
* Thorough knowledge of server and desktop configurations that will protect systems from unauthorized access and software invasion

**About Fulfillment IQ (FIQ):**

Fulfillment IQ is a supply chain engineering and transformation company that helps brands, retailers, and 3PLs design, build, and scale high-performance logistics operations.

We work at the intersection of strategy, supply chain, and technology where we solve complex, real-world problems across warehouse design, automation, order management, transportation, and end-to-end supply chain execution.

Our teams combine deep domain expertise with strong technical capability, delivering outcomes through consulting, systems implementation, and proprietary platforms that accelerate time-to-value and reduce delivery risk.

If you enjoy working in complex environments, partnering closely with clients, and seeing your work make a tangible impact on how global commerce moves, this is the place where your skills and judgment truly come to life.

**Role Overview:**

You will own hands-on configuration, testing, and continuous improvement of a global Manhattan Active WM template in a large, multi-customer program rolling out across dozens of warehouse sites a year. Working from approved functional designs, you turn requirements into standardized, reusable configuration and keep customer-specific complexity out of the template. The role works hours aligned to US business hours (an evening and night shift in IST), with occasional international travel for go-lives, planned with 6 to 8 weeks' notice (a valid US B1/B2 visa is a plus).

**Mandate:**

* Configure Manhattan Active WM independently from approved functional designs and template requirements
* Build and maintain reusable configuration components that deploy consistently across customers, sites, and environments

**Global Template Configuration**

* Configure and maintain system parameters, business rules, workflows, and operational settings
* Build reports, documents, labels, dashboards, and implementation scripts to program standards
* Manage configuration changes through Configuration Director and approved tools

**Configuration Governance and Quality**

* Keep configuration consistent with approved designs and template standards
* Avoid duplication and customer-specific dependencies; escalate design ambiguities
* Maintain accurate configuration documentation, dependencies, and change history

**Template Enhancement**

* Recommend simplifications and template enhancements from recurring implementation needs
* Provide feasibility and impact input on functional change requests
* Evaluate new Manhattan Active capabilities that reduce the need for extensions

**Testing, Deployment, and Implementation Support**

* Unit and functional testing of new configuration; support automated regression testing
* Support configuration packaging, versioning, and deployment across environments
* Troubleshoot configuration issues during SIT, UAT, go-live, and stabilization
* Transfer knowledge to client super users, regional configurators, and support teams

**Key Performance Indicators:**

* Configuration items delivered on time and first-time right
* Configuration defects found in SIT and UAT versus production
* Documentation completeness for delivered changes
* Go-live support issues resolved within agreed priority

Welcome to Haleon. We’re a purpose-driven, world-class consumer company putting everyday health in the hands of millions. In just three years since our launch, we’ve grown, evolved and are now entering an exciting new chapter – one filled with bold ambitions and enormous opportunity.
  
  
Our trusted portfolio of brands – including Sensodyne®, Panadol®, Advil®, Voltaren®, Theraflu®, Otrivin®, and Centrum® – lead in resilient and growing categories. What sets us apart is our unique blend of deep human understanding and trusted science.
  
  
Now it’s time to fully realise the full potential of our business and our people. We do this through our Win as One strategy. It puts our purpose – to deliver better everyday health with humanity – at the heart of everything we do. It unites us, inspires us, and challenges us to be better every day, driven by our agile, performance-focused culture.

**About the team**

People Solutions Excellence exists to drive executional excellence in HR operations, services and transactions. We help improve how People Solutions operates by making processes simpler, services better, decisions more data-driven, and change more successful.

We're a global team of experts in process improvement, people experience, service excellence, data and analytics, reporting, and project delivery. Working closely with our HR Centres of Excellence and People Solutions teams, we solve problems, streamline ways of working, and drive continuous improvement.

Our role is to create consistent, scalable solutions that work globally while allowing for local needs where required. We bridge the gap between business requirements and operational delivery; helping People Solutions deliver better experiences, stronger outcomes, and lasting adoption of change.

**About the role**

The **Global Recruitment Operations Manager** will play a pivotal role in leading and continuously improving Haleon’s global recruitment operations capability. You will manage the operating rhythm, standards, governance and controls that enable reliable, efficient and candidate-focused delivery across the end-to-end hiring lifecycle.

Partnering closely with Talent Acquisition, Global Process Owners, Digital & Technology, Quality & Effectiveness and PS regional teams, you will translate strategy and business need into clear operational plans, scalable ways of working and measurable service outcomes.

Success will be measured through service performance, process compliance, candidate and hiring leader experience, team capability and the sustainable value delivered through simplification, standardisation, automation and continuous improvement.

This position demands a strategic approach to streamline processes, enhance efficiency, and ensure seamless co-ordination between various operational functions. You will possess strong operational skills to effectively manage a dispersed team, drive performance, and ensure global operations activity is appropriate, timely and focused on user experience.

Key responsibilities:

* Lead, develop and engage a high-performing TA coordination team with clear priorities, accountabilities and service standards – ensuring the team is set up to effectively support Talent Acquisition colleagues and hiring managers across the globe and in different time zones.

* Own the global operations plan, capacity and day-to-day delivery across requisition administration, interview scheduling, checks, offers, pre-boarding and candidate queries.

* Resolve complex issues and escalations quickly, addressing root causes and strengthening service resilience.

* In partnership with the Global Head of People Solutions Excellence, Global Head of TA and Global Process Owners, set and embed global processes, controls, service measures and governance, with localisation only where required.

* In partnership with Talent Acquisition and Global Process Owners, clarify roles, simplify and standardise recruitment processes, hand-offs and operational assets to enable joined-up delivery and a consistent experience.

* Use technology, automation and AI to reduce effort, improve quality and expand self-service.

* Responsible for the operational implementation and adoption of recruitment process, system and service changes.

In partnership with Talent Acquisition, Quality & Effectiveness and Data & Insights teams, use operational dashboards, routine reviews, data and customer insight to provide senior stakeholders with clear reporting on performance, priorities, risks and measure impacts.  



**About you**

Technical and functional expertise:

* Significant experience leading recruitment operations, talent acquisition coordination, HR shared services or a comparable global service function.

* Proven success leading global or multi-region teams in a complex matrix organisation.

* Strong knowledge of the end-to-end recruitment lifecycle, operational controls and candidate and hiring leader experience.

* A track record of simplifying processes, improving service performance and delivering change at scale.

* Experience using recruitment technology, workflow automation and operational data to improve outcomes. Workday and ServiceNow experience is highly advantageous.

Experience managing risk, compliance, governance and third-party delivery, ideally across multiple markets.  



Leadership and behavioural capabilities:

* Demonstrable people leadership skills, with the ability to create clarity, direction and focus to build a high-performing, engaged and inclusive team.

* Exceptional stakeholder management and relationship-building skills.

* Strong communication and influencing capabilities across global and cross-functional environments, ideally with the ability to also speak French, Spanish or Polish.

* Ability to influence without direct authority and align multiple stakeholders around shared outcomes.

A continuous improvement mindset, with curiosity, practical problem-solving skills and a focus on making services simpler and better.  



**Job Posting End Date**

2026-11-23  

**Equal Opportunities**
-----------------------

Haleon are committed to mobilising our purpose in a way that represents the diverse consumers and communities who rely on our brands every day. It guides us in creating an inclusive culture, where different backgrounds and views are valued and respected – all in support of understanding and best serving the needs of our consumers and unleashing the full potential of our people. It’s important to us that Haleon is a place where all our employees feel they truly belong.
  
  
During the application process, we may ask you to share some personal information, which is entirely voluntary. This information ensures we meet certain regulatory and reporting obligations and supports the development, refinement, and execution of our inclusion and belonging programmes that are open to all Haleon employees.
  
  
The personal information you provide will be kept confidential, used only for legitimate business purposes, and will never be used in making any employment decisions, including hiring decisions.

**Adjustment or Accommodations Request**
----------------------------------------

If you require a reasonable adjustment or accommodation or other assistance to apply for a job at Haleon at any stage of the application process, please let your recruiter know by providing them with a description of specific adjustments you are requesting. We’ll provide all reasonable adjustments to support you throughout the recruitment process and treat all information you provide us in confidence.

**Note to candidates**
----------------------

The Haleon recruitment team will contact you using a Haleon email account (@haleon.com). If you are not sure whether the email you received is from Haleon, please get in touch.

**About Sukoon Health**

Sukoon provides inpatient mental healthcare for severe and complex mental health conditions and addiction. We are looking for a commercial leader who can help patients access high-quality care by strengthening referral relationships, developing effective sales teams and turning market opportunities into measurable business growth.

You will lead national sales and business development across our markets. Your work will combine time in the field with city managers and representatives, rigorous account planning, revenue-generating events and sales collateral that helps people understand Sukoon’s value. You will work closely with clinical, marketing, admissions, customer care and operations teams.

**Role Overview**

This is a role for someone who takes ownership of results and improves how other people sell. You should be comfortable accompanying representatives, demonstrating a consultative sales conversation, coaching managers and making clear decisions about account priorities and investment. You will join an existing operation with targets, processes and training in place, and strengthen execution while addressing specific gaps.

Success means more productive referral accounts, better sales-team performance, qualified opportunities from events and partnerships, and reliable progress against revenue targets. You must be able to explain what you changed, how it worked and how the team can repeat it.

**Roles & Responsibities**

Sales leadership and account development

1. Own national commercial performance

* Translate national and city revenue targets into channel, territory and account plans.
* Diagnose performance gaps using account potential, referral activity, conversion, capacity and commercial economics.
* Identify the few actions most likely to close those gaps and hold clear owners accountable.
* Maintain a credible forecast and explain variances early.
* Allocate sales effort and approved budgets to opportunities with a clear rationale.
* Work with Finance and the Head of Growth on channel economics, investment decisions and corrective action.

2. Build productive referral relationships

* Segment and prioritise doctors, clinics, hospitals and other relevant partners based on clinical relevance, account potential and relationship stage.
* Understand their unmet needs, referral barriers and current alternatives.
* Develop account plans with a specific proposition, next action, owner and date.
* Activate appropriate new accounts, deepen productive relationships and re-engage lapsed referrers.
* Work with Sukoon clinicians to build professional trust through meaningful conversations and evidence.
* Ensure partners understand referral pathways and receive timely follow-through from the relevant teams.
* Explore partnerships where they support the agreed growth strategy.
* Assess fit, expected demand, delivery requirements, economics and ownership before proposing an investment.
* Referral development remains a core responsibility; expansion into other channels must have a clear business case.

3. Coach in the field

* Spend regular time with city managers and frontline representatives. Observe real meetings, diagnose the skills or account barriers involved and demonstrate effective discovery, value explanation, objection handling and next-step agreement. Give specific feedback and follow up on whether behaviour and results improve.
* Teach managers to coach their teams consistently. Use existing training materials and performance data to identify development needs. Translate training into practice through joint visits, role-play, account reviews and individual development plans. Measure improvements in representative productivity and target attainment.

4. Build a capable sales organisation

* Clarify responsibilities, territory coverage, manager spans and account ownership. Set hiring standards, interview and assess sales talent, improve onboarding and ramp-up, and address persistent underperformance. Make staffing proposals based on workload, geography and account opportunity.
* Create a culture of preparation, honest reporting and reliable follow-through. Recognise results and effective behaviours, and ensure reviews lead to useful decisions. Develop managers who can sustain performance without every issue escalating to the national leader.

Events collateral and commercial execution

1. Create events that develop business

* Design and execute targeted clinician roundtables, facility visits, educational discussions and other relevant engagement formats. Choose the audience and format around a specific account opportunity or referral barrier. Work with clinical colleagues on content and marketing colleagues on invitations and delivery.
* Own the commercial plan for each event: target accounts, proposition, attendee recruitment, approved budget, representative preparation, intended next actions and follow-up. Track full costs and evaluate qualified opportunities, productive accounts and attributable revenue over an agreed period.
* Assign follow-up owners before the event. Ensure opportunities are recorded and progressed in the CRM. Distinguish newly generated business from influence on existing opportunities. Use results to decide which formats to repeat, improve or discontinue.

2. Know what sales collateral to build

* Audit existing materials and identify gaps by audience, sales stage and recurring question or objection. Brief marketing on assets such as referral guides, clinical capability summaries, evidence-based case examples, care-journey explanations, FAQs, presentations and event follow-up material.
* Specify the audience, purpose, message, evidence, format and intended next action for each asset. Work with clinical leaders to validate clinical content and with marketing to maintain brand consistency. Test material in real conversations, teach teams to use it and improve it based on feedback and account progression.

3. Strengthen execution across teams

* Use existing CRM and reporting systems to maintain account plans, activity quality, source attribution, next actions and forecasts. Improve data quality and sales processes where a specific performance gap warrants it. Lead reviews that result in decisions and completed actions.
* Work with admissions and customer care to ensure referral enquiries receive timely attention and a clear handoff. Escalate repeated service or coordination barriers that damage partner trust. Support the clinical team’s patient conversations through relevant information and feedback while respecting assigned ownership.

4. Exercise sound healthcare judgment

* Represent Sukoon accurately and communicate value with evidence. Protect patient confidentiality and ensure patient stories and clinical claims have appropriate approval. Build trust with clinicians, partners and families through clear, respectful communication.
* Clinical decisions remain with clinicians. Commercial targets must support clinically appropriate care and informed patient choice. You are accountable for referral-channel performance and sales execution; clinical recommendations and lengths of stay are not sales decisions.

**How accountability will work**

* Revenue and admission outcomes depend on clinical eligibility, patient choice, facility capacity and patient-facing execution. You will own the sales actions and account relationships within your control, diagnose shared barriers and coordinate resolution. Reviews will distinguish weak sales execution from other causes of performance variance.
* Productive-account and conversion definitions will use consistent windows and denominators. Registered contacts and raw visit counts will not substitute for qualified opportunities or account outcomes. Count unique referrals consistently and avoid duplicate revenue credit across channels and events.
* The scorecard will inform priorities and performance assessment. Incentive terms and weightings will be specified separately in the employment offer.

**What strong performance looks like**

City managers can explain their account priorities and coach their teams effectively. Representatives understand partner needs, communicate Sukoon’s value and secure meaningful next steps. Events create opportunities that are followed through, and collateral solves specific sales problems. Forecasts are reliable and the team can demonstrate progress against targets.

 **Requirements**

* Demonstrated commercial experience in healthcare in India, including clinician or referral-partner engagement. A record of leading sales or business-development teams, owning targets and improving results through personal intervention is essential.
* Ability to show field coaching, territory and account development, revenue-generating events and sound sales-collateral judgment. Strong commercial numeracy, CRM discipline and cross-functional execution. Willingness to spend substantial time in the field and travel regularly between markets.
* Typically 12 or more years of relevant commercial experience, with meaningful people-leadership responsibility. We will consider strong regional leaders ready for national responsibility as well as established national leaders. Evidence of performance and capability will carry more weight than title or tenure alone.
* Bachelor’s degree required. An MBA or relevant postgraduate qualification is preferred. Clear professional communication in English is essential; language capabilities relevant to our markets are valuable.

* Multi-city or multi-facility leadership

* Experience in mental healthcare, rehabilitation or addiction services is valuable but not mandatory.

title: Senior Security Consultant
description:
**Job Description – Senior Cybersecurity Incident Response Specialist**

**Experience:** 8–10 Years  
  
**Function:** Cybersecurity – Incident Response / DFIR  
  
**Role Level:** Senior

**Role Overview**

We are looking for an experienced Cybersecurity Incident Response Specialist with 8–10 years of hands-on cybersecurity experience to manage and investigate security incidents across enterprise environments.

The candidate will be responsible for end-to-end ownership of cybersecurity incidents, including triage, investigation, containment, eradication, recovery, Root Cause Analysis (RCA), malware analysis, and digital forensic analysis. The role also requires strong customer-facing skills to lead incident discussions, provide regular updates, explain technical findings, and present investigation outcomes and recommendations.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Incident Response & Investigation**

* Take end-to-end ownership of cybersecurity incidents from initial detection through closure.
* Lead investigation of Critical, High, and complex security incidents and coordinate response activities across relevant teams.
* Perform incident triage, scoping, containment, eradication, recovery, and post-incident analysis.
* Investigate incidents involving ransomware, malware, phishing, account compromise, credential theft, data exfiltration, insider threats, web attacks, lateral movement, privilege escalation, and other advanced threats.
* Analyze security alerts and correlate information across EDR, SIEM, network, identity, cloud, email, and other security technologies.
* Develop incident timelines and determine the attack vector, affected assets, compromised accounts, attacker activity, persistence mechanisms, and overall impact.
* Identify Indicators of Compromise (IOCs), attacker Tactics, Techniques, and Procedures (TTPs), and map findings to the MITRE ATT&CK framework.
* Coordinate with SOC, Threat Hunting, Threat Intelligence, IT, Cloud, Network, IAM, Application, Legal, and other stakeholders during major incidents.

**Root Cause Analysis (RCA)**

* Perform detailed **Root Cause Analysis** for security incidents.
* Determine the initial attack vector, contributing factors, security/control gaps, and reasons existing preventive or detective controls did not stop or detect the activity earlier.
* Conduct post-incident reviews and lessons-learned sessions.
* Develop clear corrective and preventive actions based on investigation findings.
* Track remediation recommendations with relevant stakeholders through closure.
* Prepare comprehensive RCA reports suitable for technical teams, management, and customers.

**Malware Analysis**

* Perform static and dynamic malware analysis to understand malicious file behavior and capabilities.
* Analyze suspicious executables, scripts, PowerShell commands, documents, URLs, and other artifacts.
* Identify malware persistence mechanisms, command-and-control activity, network indicators, file-system changes, registry modifications, and related behaviors.
* Extract IOCs and behavioral indicators for threat hunting and detection engineering.
* Perform malware sandboxing and behavioral analysis where required.
* Provide recommendations for detection, containment, and prevention based on malware-analysis findings.

**Digital Forensics**

* Perform digital forensic investigations on endpoints and other relevant systems.
* Analyze Windows/Linux artifacts, event logs, file systems, registry artifacts, browser artifacts, authentication logs, memory artifacts, and other forensic evidence.
* Perform disk and memory analysis where required.
* Collect and preserve digital evidence following appropriate forensic procedures and chain-of-custody requirements.
* Build forensic timelines and reconstruct attacker activities.
* Determine the scope and impact of compromise using forensic evidence.
* Document forensic findings clearly and maintain investigation evidence appropriately.

**Customer & Stakeholder Management**

* Act as a key technical point of contact for customers during cybersecurity incidents.
* Lead incident calls and communicate investigation progress, impact, containment status, risks, and next steps.
* Provide timely and accurate incident updates to customers and internal leadership.
* Translate complex technical investigation findings into clear business-level communication.
* Manage customer expectations during high-severity and time-sensitive incidents.
* Present RCA and forensic investigation findings to customers and senior stakeholders.
* Handle technical questions and confidently explain investigation methodology, evidence, conclusions, and recommendations.
* Coordinate with multiple internal and customer teams to drive incidents toward timely resolution.

**Incident Reporting & Documentation**

* Prepare detailed incident investigation reports, including:
* Maintain accurate incident records, evidence, investigation notes, and supporting documentation.
* Contribute to the development and improvement of Incident Response playbooks, SOPs, investigation procedures, and escalation processes.
* Executive summary
* Incident timeline
* Scope and impact
* Root cause
* Attack vector
* IOCs and TTPs
* Investigation findings
* Containment and remediation actions
* Control gaps
* Corrective and preventive recommendations
* Lessons learned

**Required Technical Skills**

The candidate should have strong hands-on experience in:

* Cybersecurity Incident Response / DFIR
* Security Incident Investigation
* Root Cause Analysis (RCA)
* Digital Forensics
* Malware Analysis
* Threat Hunting
* Endpoint and Network Investigation
* Windows and Linux Forensics
* Disk and Memory Analysis
* Log Analysis and Timeline Reconstruction
* IOC and TTP Analysis
* MITRE ATT&CK Framework
* SIEM platforms such as Splunk, Microsoft Sentinel, QRadar, or similar
* EDR/XDR platforms such as CrowdStrike, Microsoft Defender for Endpoint, SentinelOne, Cortex XDR, or similar
* Network security technologies including Firewall, IDS/IPS, Proxy, DNS, VPN, and WAF
* Cloud security investigation across AWS, Azure, and/or GCP environments
* Identity and authentication-related investigations
* Email and phishing investigations
* Forensic and malware-analysis tools such as Volatility, Autopsy, FTK, EnCase, Wireshark, Sysinternals, YARA, Ghidra, IDA, or equivalent tools
* Scripting/automation using Python, PowerShell, or similar technologies would be an advantage.

**Required Experience**

* 8–10 years of overall cybersecurity experience, with significant hands-on experience in Incident Response, DFIR, SOC, Threat Hunting, or related security domains.
* Demonstrated experience independently handling complex and high-severity cybersecurity incidents.
* Strong experience conducting RCA and presenting investigation findings.
* Hands-on experience with malware and forensic investigations.
* Experience handling customer-facing security incidents and leading technical/customer incident calls.
* Experience coordinating investigations involving multiple technical and business teams.
* Ability to work effectively under pressure during Critical/High-severity incidents.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.

**Communication & Leadership Skills**

* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong customer-facing and stakeholder-management capabilities.
* Ability to communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Ability to lead incident bridges/calls during critical incidents.
* Strong documentation and report-writing skills.
* Ability to take ownership, make investigation decisions, and drive incidents to closure.
* Ability to mentor junior Incident Response/SOC analysts and provide technical guidance during investigations.

description:

Job Category

Customer Success

Job Details

**About Salesforce**

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

**ROLE OVERVIEW**

  

The DevOps Architect — Migration Hub is the strategic owner of the CI/CD, environment management and release governance framework that powers all migration wave delivery across the Hub. Sitting at the intersection of platform engineering and delivery operations, this role designs and governs the DevOps infrastructure that enables concurrent migration teams — across Marketing Cloud Next, Agentforce Revenue Management, ITSM and Tableau Next tracks — to deploy, test, validate and release Salesforce configuration, code and data changes at Hub velocity. Unlike the hands-on DevOps Engineer (who operates day-to-day pipelines within a single track), the DevOps Architect operates at the Hub level — defining branching strategy, environment topology, pipeline standards, test automation frameworks, deployment governance and cross-wave dependency management that apply consistently to every track team. This role is accountable for ensuring the Hub never becomes a bottleneck — that release pipelines are fast, reliable, auditable and capable of supporting multiple concurrent go-lives within the same programme window. The DevOps Architect is also responsible for the platform development tooling contribution model — governing how Apex, LWC, Flow and integration code built by track teams is developed, reviewed, tested and promoted through Hub environments to production.

  
  

**RESPONSIBILITIES:** **S**

  

* **CI/CD Pipeline Architecture — Hub Standard** : Design, build and own the Hub-wide CI/CD pipeline framework using Salesforce DX, GitHub Actions and Gearset/Copado — defining the standard pipeline stages (develop validate test UAT staging production) that apply to every migration track, wave and release.
* **Environment Topology Design** : Design and manage the Hub environment topology — defining the number, purpose and refresh cadence of Developer, CI, SIT, UAT, Staging and Production environments across all active migration waves, balancing environment costs with delivery velocity requirements.
* **Branching Strategy & Version Control Governance** : Define and enforce the Hub-wide Git branching strategy — including branch naming conventions, merge policies, pull request standards, conflict resolution protocols and release tagging — ensuring all Salesforce DX source code, metadata and configuration is correctly version-controlled.
* **Scratch Org Strategy** : Design the Hub's Salesforce DX scratch org usage model — defining scratch org definitions, feature flags, shape parameters and lifecycle policies that enable track teams to develop and test in isolated, reproducible environments at scale.
* **Deployment Governance & Release Management** : Own the release management process for all migration wave deployments — defining change freeze windows, deployment sequencing, dependency maps, rollback procedures, approval gates and production deployment runbooks used across all concurrent waves.
* **Test Automation Framework** : Design and implement the Hub-wide automated test suite — including Apex test class standards, code coverage requirements, UI automation (LWC Jest, Selenium), data validation scripts and post-deployment smoke tests — integrated into every CI/CD pipeline stage.
* **Static Code Analysis & Quality Gates** : Implement and maintain static code analysis tooling (PMD, Salesforce Code Analyser, ESLint) as mandatory quality gates within the Hub pipeline — enforcing Apex best practices, Governor Limit awareness, LWC standards and security vulnerability detection before any code progresses to UAT.
* **Multi-Org & Multi-Track Pipeline Management** : Manage the complexity of concurrent multi-org pipelines across 4–5 active migration tracks — designing dependency management, cross-track metadata conflict resolution and coordinated deployment sequencing for shared Salesforce org components.
* **Data Migration Pipeline Integration** : Integrate data migration pipeline execution (ETL job scheduling, bulk load sequencing, reconciliation validation) into the Hub CI/CD framework — ensuring data migration jobs are tracked, versioned, automated and auditable alongside metadata deployments.
* **Secrets & Credential Management** : Design and enforce secure secrets management for all Hub environments — including connected app credentials, API keys, org authentication certificates, ETL connection credentials and third-party integration tokens using vault-based or CI/CD-native secrets management.
* **Monitoring & Observability** : Design the Hub's deployment monitoring and observability framework — including pipeline run dashboards, deployment success/failure metrics, apex test trend monitoring, environment health checks and post-deployment alert routing for track teams and programme leadership.
* **DevOps Engineer Mentoring & Standards** : Act as the technical lead and mentor for DevOps Engineers embedded in each migration track — setting development standards, reviewing pipeline configurations, conducting DevOps design reviews and ensuring consistent tooling adoption across all track teams.
* **Platform Development Contribution** : Design and build reusable Salesforce platform components for Hub DevOps tooling — including LWC-based deployment dashboards, Apex utilities for automated org health checks, custom metadata-driven pipeline configuration frameworks and Salesforce Flow automations for release approval workflows.
* **Continuous Improvement — Hub Feedback** : Capture DevOps lessons learned after every migration wave — pipeline failures, deployment blockers, environment contention, test coverage gaps
* **Tooling Evaluation & Adoption** : Evaluate and recommend new DevOps tooling, Salesforce release management platforms and automation frameworks — maintaining the Hub's DevOps toolkit at the leading edge of Salesforce delivery practice.

  

**CORE TECHNICAL SKILLS — MUST HAVE**

  

* **Salesforce DX & Source-Driven Development:** Expert knowledge of Salesforce DX — scratch org management, SFDX project structure, package development model (unlocked packages, managed packages), metadata API formats and CLI operations for automated deployments.
* **CI/CD Pipeline Engineering:** Hands-on expertise building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines for Salesforce deployments — using GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Azure DevOps or CircleCI combined with Gearset, Copado or custom SFDX scripting for automated validate-test-deploy workflows.
* **Gearset or Copado:** Deep practical experience with at least one enterprise Salesforce release management platform — Gearset or Copado — including pipeline configuration, org comparison, deployment validation, rollback management and test execution integration.
* **Git & Branching Strategy:** Expert-level Git proficiency — branching model design (GitFlow, trunk-based, environment-branching), merge policy enforcement, PR review standards, release tagging and conflict resolution for Salesforce metadata and Apex code repositories.
* **Salesforce Environment Management:** Proven ability to design and manage multi-org environment topologies for large programme delivery — including sandbox refresh automation, org dependency mapping, data masking for lower environments and environment capacity planning.
* **Apex & Platform Development:** Strong Apex development skills — Triggers, Batch Apex, Schedulable classes, test class authoring, Governor Limit management — required for building Hub DevOps tooling, automated health check utilities and deployment validation components.
* **Lightning Web Components & Salesforce Flow:** Ability to build LWC-based deployment dashboards, pipeline status monitors, release approval UIs and org health dashboards as internal Hub tooling deployed on the Salesforce platform.
* **Test Automation:** Experience designing and implementing automated test frameworks for Salesforce — Apex test class architecture, code coverage reporting, LWC Jest unit tests, Selenium/Playwright UI tests and data validation scripts integrated into CI/CD pipelines.
* **Static Code Analysis & Security Scanning:** Hands-on experience with Salesforce Code Analyser, PMD for Apex, ESLint for LWC and SAST tooling integrated into pipeline quality gates — defining and enforcing code quality and security standards across Hub teams.
* **Secrets & Credential Management:** Experience with vault-based secrets management (HashiCorp Vault, AWS Secrets Manager, GitHub Secrets, Azure Key Vault) for securely managing Salesforce connected app credentials, API tokens and ETL integration credentials across Hub environments.
* **Data Migration Pipeline Integration:** Understanding of ETL tool scheduling and orchestration — capable of integrating data migration job execution (Informatica, Talend, ADF, MuleSoft) into the Hub CI/CD framework alongside metadata deployments.
* **Monitoring & Observability:** Experience building deployment health dashboards and alerting — using Salesforce native monitoring, GitHub Actions workflow summaries, Grafana, Datadog or similar — for real-time pipeline visibility across concurrent wave deployments.
* **Platform Security:** Knowledge of Salesforce connected app security, named credentials, OAuth flows, IP restrictions and certificate-based authentication as they apply to CI/CD automation and Hub environment access control.

  

**PREFERRED SKILLS — GOOD TO HAVE:** **E**

  

* Experience with Copado Robotic Testing (CRT) or Provar for end-to-end Salesforce UI test automation integrated into release pipelines
* Knowledge of Salesforce unlocked package development and dependency management for componentised Hub metadata deployment
* Experience with container-based CI/CD execution (Docker, GitHub Actions runners, self-hosted runners) for Salesforce pipeline scalability
* Familiarity with Salesforce Shield — Event Monitoring, Platform Encryption and Field Audit Trail — as part of production environment governance
* Understanding of Marketing Cloud deployment tooling — SFMC deployment manager, Marketing Cloud package framework
* Experience with Tableau Server REST API and TSM CLI automation for Tableau Next content deployment pipelines
* Knowledge of infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, Ansible) for managing non-Salesforce Hub infrastructure components
* Familiarity with DataOps practices — data pipeline versioning, data contract enforcement and automated data quality gate integration
* Experience with Agentforce / AI feature deployment governance — managing prompt template versioning, agent topic configuration and guardrail policy changes through CI/CD pipelines
  

  

**EXPERIENCE REQUIREMENTS:**

  

* 10–16 years of experience in software engineering, DevOps engineering and Salesforce platform delivery
* 5+ years of hands-on Salesforce DevOps experience — owning CI/CD pipelines, environment management and release governance for large-scale Salesforce programmes
* 3+ years of experience designing DevOps frameworks for multi-track, multi-org Salesforce delivery programmes — managing 4+ concurrent release streams
* Demonstrated experience implementing Hub or programme-level DevOps standards adopted by multiple delivery teams across a shared Salesforce environment
* Proven track record mentoring and setting standards for DevOps Engineers embedded in track delivery teams
Experience integrating data migration pipeline execution into Salesforce CI/CD workflows — ETL scheduling, bulk load automation and reconciliation validation within deployment pipelines  

  

**SALESFORCE & PLATFORM CERTIFICATIONS:**

  

* Salesforce Platform Developer I (Required)
